API DOCUMENTATION

One familiar request format.

OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API

QuickstartRequest fieldsResponseAuthentication ↗Errors & retries ↗

Python quickstart

Install the OpenAI SDK, point it to the RunBridge endpoint and use the exact model ID shown above.

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_RUNBRIDGE_API_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.runbridge.ai/v1"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-5.2",
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "Build a launch checklist."}
    ],
    temperature=0.7,
    max_tokens=1024
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)

Core request fields

FieldTypeDescription
modelstringRequired. Exact GPT model ID.
messagesarrayOrdered system, user and assistant messages.
temperaturenumberControls response variation from 0 to 2.
max_tokensintegerMaximum generated output tokens.
streambooleanReturns incremental server-sent events when true.

Response shape

{
  "id": "chatcmpl_...",
  "model": "gpt-5.2",
  "choices": [{
    "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "..."},
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 24, "completion_tokens": 91}
}
